text: The Sunday scaries are your gut telling you the truth.

thread: Why your skills feel worthless at work but valuable outside it:

At work, everyone around you knows what you know.

So it feels normal.
Outside, someone 3 years behind you would pay to skip the mistakes you already made.

Same skills. Different room.

You've been standing in the room where your knowledge is ordinary. Step into the one where it's rare.

text:
The goal was never a better job.

The goal is not needing one.

thread: How to find your unfair advantage in 20 minutes:

MINUTES 0-5

Write down every skill your job made you good at. Don't filter.

MINUTES 5-10

Write down what your life taught you. What you overcame. What you taught yourself. What people come to you for.

MINUTES 10-15

Circle anything you have proof for. Results, not opinions.

MINUTES 15-20

Pick the one someone 3 years behind you would pay to learn.

That's your unfair advantage. Now build on it.

text:
You stuck with every side hustle for months.

Imagine that discipline on something you're actually built for.

thread: Sunday reset for people building their way out:

1. Review the week: what did I build?
2. Count buyers, not likes.
3. Plan 7 posts from what I know.

4. Block the build hours in my calendar.
5. Check my exit number against this month's revenue.
6. Pick one thing to stop doing.

7. Remind myself: the job funds the exit. It doesn't own me.
